evidence.summary: Ran out of oat milk on Saturday and lost about twenty orders.
evidence.quote: Last Saturday we ran out of oat milk by 11, lost maybe twenty orders.

evidence.summary: Tracks stock on a paper sheet and texts the supplier weekly.
evidence.quote: A paper sheet on the fridge, and I text my supplier every Thursday.

evidence.summary: Pays 45 GEL a month for a POS add-on that does not track inventory.
evidence.quote: We pay 45 GEL a month for a POS add-on, but it doesn't do inventory.

evidence.summary: Sent the barista to the supermarket to buy ingredients at retail price.
evidence.quote: I sent my barista to the supermarket and we paid retail, almost double the supplier price.
